title: snapshot with exclude expression `-` does not work if you specify explicit index name

labels.name: :Data Management/ILM+SLM
labels.description: DO NOT USE. Use ":StorageEngine/ILM" or ":Distributed Coordination/SLM" instead.

body:
### Elasticsearch Version

7.16.2

### Installed Plugins

_No response_

### Java Version

_bundled_

### OS Version

OS X

### Problem Description

On https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/7.16/slm-api-put-policy.html, you can see that `-*` allows you to exclude all data streams and indices and I thought a single hyphen `-` works as exclude expression.

Then I wanted to only exclude certain index and I used `-us` which resulted in the error below.
The workaround I found was  `-u*` to exclude index named `us`.

I am not sure if this is intended, but if it is, I think it might be helpful to indicate that you cannot specify explicit index name like I did and it has to be combined with wildcard `*` to do so.


>indices
(Optional, string or array of strings) Comma-separated list of data streams and indices to include in the snapshot. Supports [multi-index syntax](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/8.0/api-conventions.html#api-multi-index). Defaults to an empty array ([]), which includes all regular data streams and regular indices. To exclude all data streams and indices, use -*.

But when the index name contains hyphen, you get this error

### Steps to Reproduce

```
PUT japan
PUT us

# error pattern
PUT /_slm/policy/daily-snapshots
{
  "schedule": "0 30 1 * * ?", 
  "name": "<daily-snap-{now/d}>", 
  "repository": "my_repository", 
  "config": { 
    "indices": ["japan", "-us"], 
    "ignore_unavailable": false,
    "include_global_state": false
  }
}

PUT /_slm/policy/daily-snapshots/_execute


# successful pattern
PUT /_slm/policy/daily-snapshots
{
  "schedule": "0 30 1 * * ?", 
  "name": "<daily-snap-{now/d}>", 
  "repository": "my_repository", 
  "config": { 
    "indices": ["japan", "-u*"], 
    "ignore_unavailable": false,
    "include_global_state": false
  }
}

PUT /_slm/policy/daily-snapshots/_execute
```

Note that the response does not show you the error and you have to look in the log file to see the error.
